steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own GoldenEye 007 Nintendo 64 USA ROM. Check the required size and SHA-1 in games/goldeneye-us/profile.toml before importing. Keep the original separately. These instructions do not download or run it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use tools/import_rom.py --profile games/goldeneye-us/profile.toml to normalize your own .z64, .n64 or .v64 ROM. Build the CMake goldeneye-us-release target to produce the native goldeneye-us player. The default keeps the ROM external; an optional build that embeds it must remain private. This is manual setup from source; Portcove-managed download and completed setup or gameplay checks are not offered.
